lines.zh: 我四条腿走，背上能坐人。
lines.en: I walk on four legs, and my back can carry a rider.

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛是白的，一跑就扬。
lines.en: My mane is white and lifts when I run.

lines.zh: 我沿着草原走，蹄声很轻。
lines.en: I cross the plains, hooves light.
I have a horn on my head. It's sharp.
My white mane parts in the wind.
I round a rise and head uphill.

lines.zh: 风把我的鬃毛吹到一边。
lines.en: The wind blows my mane to one side.
Dry grass rustles under my hooves.

lines.zh: 我身上的白，在草里很显眼。
lines.en: My white stands out in the grass.
Holy Shoot fires from my horn.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子没停过，一直在走。
lines.en: My hooves haven't stopped. I keep walking.

lines.zh: 尾巴在后面甩，我走得很稳。
lines.en: My tail swings behind; I walk steady.
I go to higher ground.
The wind suits me better there.
I stand and my mane moves in the wind.
Grass seeds tap against my horn in the wind.

lines.zh: 草原上跑起来，我的鬃毛先亮。
lines.en: On the savanna my mane lights first.
I lower my head for a bite of grass.
This grass is badly dried out.
I raise my head and snort.
I paw at the ground.

lines.zh: 我在等一个能骑我的人。
lines.en: I'm waiting for someone who can ride me.
I've seen one of those.
He got on and I didn't throw him.
Then he unbuckled the reins and left.
The saddle is still empty; I keep waiting.
I take another bite of grass.
The wind pushes the clouds along.
You smell of having been tamed.

lines.zh: 我头上的角很尖，快要碰到你手里。
lines.en: My horn is sharp and almost touching what you hold.

lines.zh: 你身上有驯过的味道，手很稳。
lines.en: You have a tamed scent, and steady hands.
I rarely do this.
You lower the reins, and I lower my head.
Do you want to ride?
Don't climb up yet.
Let me look at you.
I walk one circle around you.
All right. I won't move.
Get on from the left.
Mind my horn.
My horn is very sharp.
You've got my mane.
On the savanna, my saddle is ready.
Which way do you want?
Blood runs down my stripes to my hooves.
My hooves slip on the wet grass.
Blood runs from under my mane.
I toss my mane and blood spatters the grass.
All four hooves brace. No further.
The wind is still in my mane.
A striped body that can carry a rider.
My horn is still sound.
Then I can still fight.
I level my horn.
Is that stuff feed?
I smell wheat.
I lift a hoof and take a step.
My muzzle settles into your palm.
I lower my head and eat.
This wheat is very sweet.
When I'm done I raise my head and look at you.
Anything else in your pocket?
You rub my nose.
The smell of grain stops my hooves.
That's acceptable enough.
You put a hand on my back.
You hit my shoulder and bounced back.
My hooves are nailed to the ground.
That should have numbed your hands.

lines.zh: 我的条纹擦过你的肩甲。
lines.en: My stripes brush your pauldron.
My hoof lands by your foot.
You step back.
I snort once and step away.
Then I walk off.
The horn on my head is white.
My hooves came down on no one.
There are a few others on the plains.
They're wilder than I am.
I come close and they scatter.
Because I smell of people.
I don't blame them.
I stand on the rise and watch them run.
They run beautifully.
I used to run like that.
Now I have other things.
I turn and go back.
I lower my head and bite the grass off.
That mouthful has soil in it.
The dry grass is tough; I chew slowly.

lines.zh: 草里有几颗落下的野果。
lines.en: A few wild berries in the grass.
A fruit rolls to my hooves and I lower my head.
Too ripe. A little sour.
I finish it anyway.
I take a drink at the water.
The stream water is very cold.
I raise my head and shake.
Something's moving below the rise.
I dip my horn that way.
That isn't a horse.
My white horn lines up on the slope below.
I sit back on my hocks and gather.
I count the gaps in its hoofbeats.
My horn points at your chest.
It checks its feet and stands.
Then now's the time.
I charge down the slope.
My horn stays on it.
It flinched away.
I follow it around the rise.
It's not slow.
But it turns worse than I do.
I cut across the inside.
It runs into me.
The impact throws it back.
I wheel and cut in again.
It's up.
Its breathing thickened, closer now.
My breathing is still even.
I gather my hooves and charge down the slope again.
This one lands clean.
I drive my horn in.
That tosses it up.
It hits the grass and rolls once.
My forehooves leave the ground.
My forehooves come down hard.
It rolls out from under them.
I turn to find it.
It's already up.
It strikes my flank.
Grass prints mark where my hooves fell.
I wheel and charge again.
It turns aside and dodges.
Striped all over, with a horn.
The wind comes head on.
My mane lifts.
I raise my head and scent grass on the wind.
There are no other Digimon here.
A string of hoofprints lands on the hard soil.
My hooves on hard earth. Solid.
I run a short stretch.
Running, my mane streams out.
I check my hooves and stand.
And look back at my prints.
A straight line.

lines.zh: 远处有个身影，立着不动。
lines.en: A figure stands motionless in the distance.
I stay still. Let him go first.
Fire catches my mane and I shake it loose.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下来，摔得很闷。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and land hard.

lines.zh: 水没过我的背，我拼命往上游，鳞都湿了。
lines.en: Water over my back; I swim up hard, scales soaked.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀离地面，摔出去。
lines.en: The blast lifts me off the ground and throws me.
An arrow is buried under my mane.
A light wraps my legs.
The grass is all withered and hunger makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，整片草原都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and the whole plain lights up.

lines.zh: 脚下没有草，我一直在掉。
lines.en: No grass below. I keep falling.
